bio: This traditional inn dating back over 300 years serves regional cuisine made with seasonal and predominantly locally sourced ingredients. The menu ranges from classics such as Hirschwirts Gaisburger Marsch (a traditional Swabian beef stew) and Swabian tripe ragout to Mediterranean-influenced dishes such as fried Atlantic sea bream fillet with a white wine sauce on bell peppers and courgettes with risotto. This elegant family-run establishment has comfortable guestrooms....
